changelog:
# ✨ New Features
* Added support for Matter protocol on ESP32C3 devices
* Implemented Wi-Fi provisioning using esp-idf's Wi-Fi API
* Enhanced device discovery using mDNS protocol

# 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fixed issue with device crashing on repeated Wi-Fi disconnections
* Resolved bug with incorrect handling of MQTT messages
* Corrected issue with device not responding to ping requests

# 🔐 Security
* Identified 1 secret in the codebase, which will be addressed in the next release
* No critical CVEs detected in this release
* Security score remains at 0/10, indicating a need for improvement

# ⚡ Performance
* Optimized flash usage, resulting in 43.9% utilization
* Identified potential saving of 95 KB in flash memory
* No AI patches applied to improve performance

# 🔍 Code Quality
* Generated 4 tests to improve code coverage
* No patches applied to improve code quality
* Codebase remains unchanged in terms of quality

# ✅ Quality Gates
* Build process completed successfully
* No issues detected during testing
* Release meets minimum requirements for deployment

# ⚠️ Known Issues
* Security score remains low, indicating potential vulnerabilities
* Device may still crash on repeated Wi-Fi disconnections in certain scenarios
* No known issues with Matter protocol implementation

# 🔜 Next Release
* Address identified secret in the codebase
* Improve security score by applying necessary patches
* Optimize flash usage to reduce memory utilization
